title: Trust Transfer Mechanics
equation: Trust Transfer Mechanics = Credibility × Audience Overlap × Consistency × Proof Relevance
hook: Building trust from zero is slow. Borrowing it from someone your customers already trust is way faster.
statement: Borrowed credibility speeds up growth faster than almost anything you can build alone.
explainer: People already trust certain brands, creators, and experts. A real co-sign from one of them skips months of proving yourself. But only if their audience is actually your buyer.
sop: List 5 to 10 people or brands your ideal customer already trusts.
Cut anyone whose audience doesn't actually match your buyer.
Score Credibility, Audience Overlap, Consistency, and Proof Relevance 1 to 10.
Send your top match one small ask, like a quote or joint post.
Put that co-sign front and center in your next launch.
equation_example: Credibility 9, Audience Overlap 7, Consistency 8, Proof Relevance 6. 9 × 7 × 8 × 6 = 3,024. Higher means the partnership will actually move buyers. Lower, especially weak overlap, means it looks nice but sells little.
question: Name one person or brand your customers already trust that you could reach out to this week.
closing_statement: Someone else's trust can be your fastest way in.
caption:
Principle Nº 99: Trust Transfer Mechanics

Building trust from zero is slow. Borrowing it from someone your customers already trust is way faster.

Borrowed credibility speeds up growth faster than almost anything you can build alone.

Your turn: Name one person or brand your customers already trust that you could reach out to this week.
